blocks.section: 7.2.10.2 POLE CLAMP SHAFT/KNOB ASSEMBLY AND SHAFT TIP REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Turn the pole clamp shaft/knob assembly counterclockwise to remove it from the pole clamp extrusion, and loosen the pole clamp shaft tip from the shaft/knob assembly.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.2 POLE CLAMP SHAFT/KNOB ASSEMBLY AND SHAFT TIP REPLACEMENT
blocks.content:  Note: The pole clamp shaft tip has a long shaft that is pressed into the threaded pole clamp shaft/knob assembly.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.2 POLE CLAMP SHAFT/KNOB ASSEMBLY AND SHAFT TIP REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Turn the pole clamp shaft/knob assembly back into the pole clamp extrusion. Using the wide-head pliers, remove the pole clamp shaft tip and replace the tip, if necessary.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.2 POLE CLAMP SHAFT/KNOB ASSEMBLY AND SHAFT TIP REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Install  the  replacement  pole  clamp  shaft/knob  assembly  into  the  pole  clamp extrusion by turning the shaft/knob assembly clockwise into the extrusion until the threaded portion is visible.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.2 POLE CLAMP SHAFT/KNOB ASSEMBLY AND SHAFT TIP REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Press the pole clamp shaft tip into the screw hole recess on the shaft/knob assembly and turn the shaft/knob assembly clockwise until the shaft tip is secure against the pole clamp extrusion.

blocks.section: 7.2.10.2 POLE CLAMP SHAFT/KNOB ASSEMBLY AND SHAFT TIP REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: Replacement of the pole clamp shaft/knob assembly and the pole clamp shaft tip is routine maintenance and no verification procedure is normally required. However, if the infuser may  have  been  damaged  during  the  replacement  procedure,  perform  the  PVT in Section 5.2 .

blocks.section: REAR ENCLOSURE AND HANDLE GASKETS REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: REAR ENCLOSURE AND HANDLE GASKETS REPLACEMENT

blocks.section: REAR ENCLOSURE AND HANDLE GASKETS REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: The recommended tool for this procedure is needle nose pliers.

blocks.section: REAR ENCLOSURE AND HANDLE GASKETS REPLACEMENT
blocks.content: The replacement parts for this procedure are:
Gasket, Rear Enclosure
Gasket, Handle
To replace the rear enclosure and handle gaskets, see Figure 7-9 , then proceed as follows:
Turn off the infuser and disconnect the device from AC power.
Remove the battery as described in Section 7.2.4 .
Separate the rear enclosure and main chassis assembly as described in Section 7.2.8 .
Remove the rear enclosure and handle gaskets from the rear enclosure assembly.
Install the replacement gaskets in the exact reverse order of removal.
Join  the  rear  enclosure  and  main  chassis  assembly  in  the  exact  reverse  order of separation.
Reinstall the battery and connect the device to AC power.
To verify successful rear enclosure and handle gaskets replacement, perform the PVT in Section 5.2 .
